column1: # VITAL 4.0 reference doses (ED05) - Allergen Bureau, "Recommended Reference Doses",
# Table 1 of the VITAL 4.0 Summary and FAQ, August 2024 (VITAL 4.0 column).
# Values are mg of TOTAL PROTEIN of the allergen, rounded from the ED05.
# Action Limit (ppm) = rfdMg / consumption amount (kg), capped by maxActionPpm when set.
# Cashew and pistachio share one reference dose, as do walnut and pecan.
# Lupin and mustard are Risk Management Values
# (lupin 15,0 and mustard 0,4) and are carried by the NL_ED05 grid.
# Mollusc is a VSEP Risk Management Value based on the ED05 for crustacea.
# allergenCode must match bcpg:allergenCode on the allergen characteristic.
# proteinPerc is optional: leave it empty when the declared quantity is already
